name: Hitozuma Juurin Shiiku ~Himei ga Kyousei ni Kawaru made Shitsukete Yaru!~
original_name: 人妻蹂躙飼育 ～悲鳴が嬌声に変わるまで躾けてやる！～
source:
"Mmh, mmh, mmmmmmmmhhhh...!"
"Well, I'll be off, then..."

Toshihiro Mizuguchi leaves his home and heads off for work.
The muffled groans of a woman behind him fade into the distance...

He arrives at work, sits at his desk, and glances over at his boss, Tsukasa Mochizuki.
But he doesn't seem to be in particularly high spirits.
So Toshihiro goes up and shamelessly asks him what's wrong.
His boss, Mochizuki, "It's nothing, really. I didn't mean to make you worry... I'm all right. Thank you for your hard work, as always."
Toshihiro can't help but crack an ominous smile.

"I'm home."
He arrives home and switches on the lights, and heads into the lounge.

"Mmh... mmh... mhmm-mmmmhm..."
"Looks like somebody's been enjoying themselves!"

With the lights on, he looks down.
"You know, my boss was really funny today. He was trying so hard to hide his desperation. I bet he's really worried right now, don't you? He's probably wondering where his wife Sanae could be. I bet that's all that's running through his mind. I wonder if he'll screw up again at work tomorrow."

"Mm! Mmm! Mmmmmmmmmmm...!!!"
"What are you giving me that look for? You should be more worried about yourself than him, eh, Sanae?"

A grin spreads across his face... as he looks down at his boss's wife, Sanae Mochizuki.

translation:
“嗯、嗯、嗯嗯嗯嗯……！”
“那我走了……”

水口利广离开家去上班。
身后女人被捂住的呻吟声渐渐远去……

他到达公司，坐在工位上，瞥了一眼上司望月司。
但上司似乎情绪不太好。
于是利广上前毫不在意地问他怎么了。
上司望月说：“没什么，真的。不是有意让你担心……我没事。一如既往辛苦你了。”
利广不禁露出了不怀好意的笑容。

“我回来了。”
他回到家中，打开灯，走进客厅。

“嗯……嗯……嗯嗯嗯……”
“看来某人玩得很开心啊！”

灯光亮起，他低头看去。
“你知道吗，我上司今天真有意思。他拼命掩饰自己的不安。他现在肯定很担心，你说是吧？他大概在想他妻子早苗到底在哪里。我打赌他满脑子想的都是这个。不知道明天工作的时候他会不会又搞砸。”

“嗯！嗯！嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……！！！”
“你用那种眼神看我干嘛？比起担心他，你更应该担心自己吧，嗯，早苗？”

他咧嘴笑着……俯视着上司的妻子——望月早苗。
